fullcite: Iversen 30 (M. Iversen, Grid Transition Observatory, "Firming the Unfirmable," 9/30/30)
spoken: Every large-load contract we reviewed was firmed by an existing gas unit whose scheduled retirement was subsequently deferred
fulltext: Operators contracting for round-the-clock supply cannot meet that profile from variable renewables alone. Every large-load contract we reviewed was firmed by an existing gas unit whose scheduled retirement was subsequently deferred. The deferrals average most of a decade.

fullcite: Bergstrom 31 (A. Bergstrom, Assoc. of Utility Commissioners, 2/22/31)
spoken: A pause in new requests does not repeal an adopted tariff
fulltext: The tariffs at issue were adopted through notice-and-comment. A pause in new requests does not repeal an adopted tariff; it reduces the number of customers to whom it applies.
